JoyRoute links

Use JoyRoute for GPS JoyStick button links

OffOn

For every link page, in this browser only.

How it works

  1. Tap a place's GPS JoyStick button on any link page.
  2. JoyRoute tells GPS JoyStick to teleport, out of sight, and notes the jump and cooldown in its notification.
  3. Pokémon GO opens at the new spot.

Needs JoyRoute on this phone. JoyRoute's Settings (gear) brings you back here.
